recentItems.title: KICKING OFF OUR CHAMPIONS LEAGUE CAMPAIGN 💫 | Arsenal prepare for Napoli | Inside Training
recentItems.description:
Go behind the scenes with the Arsenal squad for our final training session at Sobha Realty Training Centre before the team travelled to Italy for our opening Champions League game of the 2026/27 campaign.

Watch as the team work out in the gym, warm-up on the training pitches before taking part in small-sided games.

#arsenal #ucl

Enjoy highlights, training, behind the scenes and documentaries to get closer to the likes of Bukayo Saka, Martin Odegaard, Alessia Russo, Leah Williamson, Kai Havertz, Kim Little, Declan Rice, Ben White, Stina Blackstenius and more.
